name: spec-control
description: Mission control for every agent change across your repositories. Never miss a change.

scripts.dev: bun run scripts/build-ui.ts && bun run src/server/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run scripts/build-ui.ts && bun run scripts/build.ts
scripts.build:desktop: bun run build && cd desktop && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.test:fast: bun test --parallel=8 --timeout=15000 --path-ignore-patterns test/scanner.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/agentSessions.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/terminalSessions.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/pull.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/cleanup.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/autoMergeCleanup.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/staleChanges.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/proposalSessions.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/shipAutoMerge.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/pullRequests.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/shipPreflight.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/sessionPrompt.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/dismissChange.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/resolvePrConflicts.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/workStatus.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/consoleSession.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/worktreeScan.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/projectConsole.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/pullResolve.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns test/reportedState.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
